summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Enhanced FocusNote dashboard with ADHD-optimized design. Backend API testing achieved 85.7% success rate (same as previous iteration). Frontend testing achieved 90% success rate with all core ADHD-friendly features working correctly including AI task parsing, streak tracking, Focus Mode (locked for free users), Brain Dump auto-save, and task completion animations.

minor_bugs.impact: Minor routing inconsistency, doesn't affect functionality

/api/profile - Profile with streak and stats working

design_assessment.details: Calming lavender colors (#7F77DD), white background, generous whitespace, no anxiety-inducing notifications. Perfect for ADHD users.
Displays correctly in top bar with flame icon and day count
Shows locked state with lock icon for free plan users as expected
Green checkmark animation triggers correctly on task completion
Auto-saves after 3 seconds as specified, collapsible section works

AI task input parses natural language and creates tasks (GPT-4o-mini)
Today section shows max 3 tasks sorted by priority
Focus Mode button shows locked state for free users

Task completion updates and processes correctly

ADHD-friendly design with calming colors and whitespace
